    Changing the root of a star model #

    periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "for odd A, root it at its middle vertex". A covering π : ℤΔ → Q and its deck data transport along an isomorphism e : Δ ≃ Δ' of star models (any graph isomorphism; the heights shift by δ to match the two-colourings).
